notes.title: Update v17.0 – Optimization & Key Fixes
notes.content:
[p]Thank you for continuing to explore the dark depths of [i]Haus Of Irndrous[/i]!
The new version 17.0 brings several important changes to improve stability and the overall experience. Here's what's new:[/p][p]🔧 [b]Highlights of v17.0:[/b][/p][list][*][p]General performance optimization[/p][/*][*][p]Minor visual bug fixes[/p][/*][*][p]Improved enemy AI behavior[/p][/*][*][p]Lighting adjustments in key areas[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed collision issues and blocking zones[/p][/*][*][p]Early setup for future content expansions[/p][/*][/list][p]👀 [b]What’s Next?[/b]
This is just the beginning. More content and improvements are coming soon, fueled by your feedback and support.[/p][p]💬 We'd love to hear from you! Share your thoughts in the forums or on social media.[/p]

notes.title: Hotfix (v10.0) - 08/06/2025
notes.content:
[p][b]Hello everyone![/b]
We’re excited to announce a new update for [i]Haus Of Irndrous[/i] that implements several ideas suggested by you!
This version includes improved GPS systems and in-game guidance, new missions, and other essential enhancements to enrich the gameplay experience.[/p][p]Thank you for your feedback and continued support. We remain committed to polishing every detail to deliver the best possible version of [i]Haus Of Irndrous[/i].
Enjoy the update… and keep uncovering the mysteries that await you in the Afgarn mansion.[/p][p]— [i]Yxtopia Studios[/i][/p]

notes.title: Hotfix (v8.3) - 22/09/24
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We’re excited to announce a new update for Haus Of Irndrous that addresses several translation errors in the written content of the game. This update ensures that the texts are more accurate and aligned with the original story and context, providing a clearer and more immersive narrative experience.

Thank you for your feedback and continued support. We're committed to improving the game and delivering the best possible version of Haus Of Irndrous. Enjoy the update, and keep uncovering the mysteries that await you in the Afgarn mansion!

-Yxtopia Studios.
